data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mṛga', meaning 'light' or 'luminous'. In Hindu mythology, Meraz is a name associated with the god Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver of light and knowledge. The name carries the spiritual message of illumination and enlightenment. The name Meraz carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Meraz usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Meraz is a name of great power and strength, representing the mountain of the gods and the foundation of the universe. It is a name that inspires courage and protection, and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and resilient.
data.etymology: Meraz belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Luminous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meraz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
